elder_dragon.subject: a huge ancient red dragon with cracked crimson scales, a pale yellow belly, long curved horns and a ragged frill, standing on all four legs in side view with its head lowered and stretched forward, breathing one straight stream of orange fire toward the right. Both wings are half-open and lifted above its back, and its single long tail curves along the ground behind it. One broken stone pillar stands beside its front claws, with a few embers drifting behind the wings.
